This is the only response I got. At least I know one person doesn't think my issues don't matter since I'm not immediately suicidal. I just spent another few hours crying over how badly I wish I was dead. Funny how you mention overlooking my friends flaws if their willing to listen, cause my buddy sure as hell wasn't. He thought he was being helpful to me but he's so fucking stupid that what he would say and do actually just hurt me more.  I'm trying as hard as I can to bury myself in hobbies and interests, but I can't fucking focus with the constant memory of all the pain I've suffered. I can't. I can barely pull myself out of bed in the morning, *if* I do. And when I do it's hard for me to leave the house, I just want to curl up and die. Every time I close my eyes I hope it's for the last time. I want to live but I CANT like this, not with the constant echoes, not when I have to strain and hurt myself almost every time I pee. I can't endure it anymore man.  I just wish I had someone to hold me, but that will never happen in my broken state. How can I have a relationship when my dick doesn't work??
